name: MSEntraID_GetSignInsByIP
author: 3lina, StrangeBee
description: Pull all Microsoft Entra ID sign ins across the tenant that originated from a given IP address, within the specified amount of time.

configurationItems.name: client_id
configurationItems.description: Client ID/Application ID of Microsoft Entra ID Registered App

configurationItems.name: client_secret
configurationItems.description: Secret for Microsoft Entra ID Registered Application

configurationItems.name: lookup_range
configurationItems.description: Check for sign ins in the last X days. Should be between 1 and 31 days.

configurationItems.name: lookup_limit
configurationItems.description: Display no more than this many sign ins.
